scope: Add bounded malformed PDF UNDERLAYDEFINITION OBJECTS-body recovery and CLI disposition controls across six DWG revisions.

source.kind: scratch-only DWGs authored at test runtime by the in-tree DWG writer; the valid typed seed is converted to a raw mutated frame and injected with matching custom-class registration
source.object: PDF UNDERLAYDEFINITION carrying a file name and sheet name. The one-bit mutation search preserves the validated common prologue and stays within the declared body-bit span.

implementation.controls: Each mutated source reads successfully with one object parse failure, zero entity parse failures, one failed object frame, exact source-frame accounting, and the following LINE callback. Strict ASCII/Binary conversion preserves the destination sentinel. Explicit-partial ASCII/Binary conversion succeeds and reopens with the retained LINE and VPORT. AC1027 reader recovery passes, while both CLI modes stop at the established source-reference qualification gate.

results.outputQualification: AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, and AC1032 pass strict refusal plus explicit-partial ASCII/Binary readback. AC1027 remains reader-only at the source-reference gate.

validation.directControl: python3 -B tests/dwg2dxf_cli_contract_tests.py --converter build-gcc/dwg2dxf/dwg2dxf --writer build-gcc/libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip --partial-read-only: PASS; 172 base strict/partial/readback controls, 28 controls each for VBA_PROJECT, GROUP, DICTIONARY, TV_DEVICE_PROPERTIES, POINTPATH, PARTIAL_VIEWING_INDEX, CURVEPATH, PLOTSETTINGS, and PDF UNDERLAYDEFINITION; 15 BLOCKREPRESENTATION_DATA controls; 18 controls each for VX_CONTROL and VX_TABLE_RECORD

limitations: Generated parser-recovery and CLI disposition evidence only; it does not establish underlay application semantics, producer prevalence, or interoperability.
Only the PDF UNDERLAYDEFINITION class profile is covered; DGN and DWF class profiles are not covered.
The generated object has no independently qualified owner dictionary membership or matched UNDERLAY entity; this receipt does not establish graph closure.
AC1027 output remains unqualified behind the source-reference closure gate.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
